statusDefinitions.assessment_pending: No adequate current implementation and acceptance evidence was reviewed; this is not a finding of absence.
statusDefinitions.verified: Requires current, directly attributable evidence that the full criterion passes.
statusDefinitions.partial: Requires current evidence that some, but not all, of the criterion is satisfied.
statusDefinitions.missing: Requires adequate evidence that the capability is absent or fails its criterion.

mvpRequirements.title: Apache HugeGraph local Docker
mvpRequirements.criterion: Compose starts HugeGraph, persisted data survives restart, and the graph service is internal-only by default.
mvpRequirements.limitation: No Compose/runtime/network inspection or restart test was performed.
mvpRequirements.recommendedChange: Inspect the Compose service and network bindings, then record a clean start, graph write/read, restart persistence, and host-port exposure check.

mvpRequirements.title: Automatic graph schema initialization
mvpRequirements.criterion: Fresh startup initializes the expected schema; repeat startup is idempotent.
mvpRequirements.limitation: Schema code and fresh/repeat startup behavior were not inspected or executed.
mvpRequirements.recommendedChange: Capture schema-manifest coverage and test clean initialization, repeat initialization, and incompatible-version failure without data loss.

mvpRequirements.title: Jira JSON ingestion
mvpRequirements.criterion: Synthetic Jira fixture imports Project/WorkItem/Person and evidence records with configurable mapping and per-record validation.
mvpRequirements.limitation: Fixtures, importer behavior, mapping configuration, and rejection evidence were not reviewed.
mvpRequirements.recommendedChange: Run the synthetic fixture through the configured mapper; assert expected vertices, provenance, malformed-record isolation, and repeat-import idempotency.

mvpRequirements.title: Git repository/GitLab ingestion
mvpRequirements.criterion: The local demo repository and GitLab-style MR/pipeline fixture produce linked repository, ref, commit, MR, and pipeline facts.
mvpRequirements.limitation: No connector, fixture, or persisted graph links were checked.
mvpRequirements.recommendedChange: Ingest a temporary local repository and fixture, then verify commit-to-MR/pipeline/work-item links and their evidence without network access.

mvpRequirements.title: Code parsing
mvpRequirements.criterion: Python and TypeScript demo files produce symbols, source ranges, imports/calls, and dependency edges without LLM parsing.
mvpRequirements.limitation: Parser implementation and golden fixtures were not reviewed or run.
mvpRequirements.recommendedChange: Run language-specific golden parser fixtures and compare exact symbol names, source ranges, and statically resolvable import/call edges.

mvpRequirements.title: Canonical entity generation
mvpRequirements.criterion: Every imported canonical entity has stable canonical_id; identical re-ingestion adds no logical duplicate.
mvpRequirements.limitation: Identity generation and duplicate/collision behavior were not inspected or tested.
mvpRequirements.recommendedChange: Compare canonical IDs and logical vertex/edge counts across two identical imports; add explicit collision and ambiguous-source cases.

mvpRequirements.title: Jira graph
mvpRequirements.criterion: The Jira project/work-item subgraph is queryable with provenance.
mvpRequirements.limitation: Graph contents and provenance traversal were not inspected.
mvpRequirements.recommendedChange: Query fixture project/work-item nodes and trace at least one returned fact to its source event and ingestion run.

mvpRequirements.title: Code graph
mvpRequirements.criterion: Repository→file→symbol and code-dependency subgraphs are queryable with exact source locations.
mvpRequirements.limitation: Graph query results and source-location mapping were not inspected.
mvpRequirements.recommendedChange: Verify a persisted repository/file/function path and dependency edge, including revision, path, and exact line/column range.

mvpRequirements.title: Meta graph
mvpRequirements.criterion: Sources, runs, domains, schema/ontology versions, validation, and quality records are queryable as meta graph.
mvpRequirements.limitation: Meta-graph schema, data, and statistics derivation were not audited.
mvpRequirements.recommendedChange: Reconcile a completed ingestion run, source/domain/version records, graph statistics, and validation run against their persisted meta-graph values.

mvpRequirements.title: Cross-graph linking
mvpRequirements.criterion: The full demo path is traversable forward and reverse with evidence.
mvpRequirements.limitation: No persisted end-to-end graph path or edge evidence was reviewed.
mvpRequirements.recommendedChange: Assert the ordered Jira→MR→commit→file→function→dependency→pipeline→documentation path and its reverse traversal from fixture-backed graph data.

mvpRequirements.title: Provenance
mvpRequirements.criterion: Cross-domain edges carry evidence and creation status; lineage reaches source capture and run.
mvpRequirements.limitation: Evidence coverage and lineage endpoints were not measured.
mvpRequirements.recommendedChange: Measure evidence coverage over all demo bridge edges and trace representative deterministic and inferred facts to source capture/run.

mvpRequirements.title: Graph validation
mvpRequirements.criterion: Seeded invalid data yields expected findings; hard-invalid edges are prevented or quarantined.
mvpRequirements.limitation: No validation rules, seeded invalid graph, or UI result was inspected or executed.
mvpRequirements.recommendedChange: Seed invalid endpoint/domain/provenance cases; assert hard-gate mutation rejection or quarantine and reconcile persisted findings with the admin view.

mvpRequirements.title: Query API
mvpRequirements.criterion: Versioned REST APIs return real entity/search/query/evidence data and enforce query policy.
mvpRequirements.limitation: API contracts, result origin, and policy enforcement were not checked.
mvpRequirements.recommendedChange: Exercise versioned API entity/search/path requests against persisted fixtures, then test depth, result, timeout, and relationship-policy boundaries.

mvpRequirements.title: Impact analysis query
mvpRequirements.criterion: Changing the demo function yields the golden blast-radius set and evidence paths within configured bounds.
mvpRequirements.limitation: No golden impact query, path evidence, or bounds test was executed.
mvpRequirements.recommendedChange: Run the golden directional impact case; compare exact result set, inclusion paths, cycle handling, and configured depth/result/time caps.

mvpRequirements.title: Path query
mvpRequirements.criterion: Jira issue→function path matches the golden ordered vertex/edge sequence.
mvpRequirements.limitation: The expected path and current query behavior were not checked.
mvpRequirements.recommendedChange: Execute known, unknown, and over-depth path cases and compare the demo result with the documented ordered golden sequence.

mvpRequirements.title: Search/query UI
mvpRequirements.criterion: Search/query UI uses real APIs and displays an error state when the API is unavailable, never demo fallback data.
mvpRequirements.limitation: UI behavior, API binding, and failure state were not inspected or run.
mvpRequirements.recommendedChange: Trace UI data to API responses, then stop the API and verify a visible error/degraded state with no canned domain answers.

mvpRequirements.title: Graph visualizer
mvpRequirements.criterion: Visualizer renders bounded real subgraphs, typed edges, highlighted paths, and provenance.
mvpRequirements.limitation: No visual/API integration or result-bound behavior was reviewed.
mvpRequirements.recommendedChange: Render a persisted demo path, inspect node/edge types and evidence affordances, and verify the server/client cap blocks over-expansion.

mvpRequirements.title: Admin ingestion/validation UI
mvpRequirements.criterion: Admin screens show actual ingestion status/counts, graph statistics, validation findings, and quality values.
mvpRequirements.limitation: Admin screens and backend/meta-graph reconciliation were not audited.
mvpRequirements.recommendedChange: Reconcile each displayed run/count/finding/quality value against API and graph records; confirm route separation is not treated as authorization.

mvpRequirements.title: VS Code extension
mvpRequirements.criterion: Opening the demo symbol retrieves Jira/commit/dependency/document/evidence context and exact source range.
mvpRequirements.limitation: Extension-host behavior and exact source navigation were not exercised.
mvpRequirements.recommendedChange: Run an extension-host test on the canonical demo symbol and assert context fields, offline behavior, and exact file/range navigation.

mvpRequirements.title: Local GraphRAG
mvpRequirements.criterion: GraphRAG retrieves graph/document evidence and citations; model-down mode returns structured evidence/fallback.
mvpRequirements.limitation: Retrieval, citations, local model execution, model-down behavior, and true-inference evidence were not checked.
mvpRequirements.recommendedChange: Run a golden grounded question with local inference enabled, verify citations against graph/source evidence, then stop the model and verify structured fallback.

mvpRequirements.title: Useful read-only agent workflow
mvpRequirements.criterion: TraceImpactAgent answers the demo request using allowlisted read tools within execution budgets.
mvpRequirements.limitation: Agent contract, tool registry, output evidence, and budget enforcement were not inspected or run.
mvpRequirements.recommendedChange: Execute the demo workflow; capture tool allowlist/audit evidence, citations, budget-exhaustion behavior, and a negative write-tool registration check.

mvpRequirements.title: MCP core graph access
mvpRequirements.criterion: MCP exposes the same entity/path/impact/evidence semantics as REST and advertises no write tool.
mvpRequirements.limitation: MCP tool schemas, REST parity, and capability list were not inspected or run.
mvpRequirements.recommendedChange: Compare MCP and REST results for the same fixture-backed path/impact requests and assert capability enumeration contains no mutation tools.

mvpRequirements.title: Logging
mvpRequirements.criterion: Correlation-aware structured logs cover startup, ingestion, query, validation, RAG/agent, and failures without secrets.
mvpRequirements.limitation: Logs, correlation propagation, and redaction tests were not inspected.
mvpRequirements.recommendedChange: Capture representative success/failure logs across each workflow, trace a single correlation ID, and test secret/token redaction.

mvpRequirements.title: Metrics
mvpRequirements.criterion: Machine-readable local metrics expose ingestion/query/model/agent/failure counters and latencies.
mvpRequirements.limitation: No metrics endpoint, series coverage, or optional-observability profile was checked.
mvpRequirements.recommendedChange: Scrape the local metrics endpoint after representative workflows and verify required counters/latencies while confirming observability remains optional.

mvpRequirements.title: Backup
mvpRequirements.criterion: A checksummed graph/application backup artifact is generated from the demo environment.
mvpRequirements.limitation: Backup command, artifact contents, checksum, and failure semantics were not reviewed or executed.
mvpRequirements.recommendedChange: Create a backup from populated demo data, verify manifest/checksum and required state coverage, and assert failures cannot produce success-shaped receipts.

mvpRequirements.title: Restore
mvpRequirements.criterion: Restore into a clean graph reproduces expected counts and golden path/impact queries.
mvpRequirements.limitation: No clean-target restore, count comparison, or post-restore query was executed.
mvpRequirements.recommendedChange: Restore into a verified empty target; compare expected graph counts and rerun golden path/impact queries from the restored state.

mvpRequirements.title: Automated tests
mvpRequirements.criterion: Unit, contract, integration, security, and E2E suites execute locally and produce a report.
mvpRequirements.limitation: This audit ran no tests and inspected no test/source binding. Parent reports 45 focused regression outcomes passed, Ruff exit 0, no editor problems, and full pytest exit 0 with 1,091 passed, 15 skipped, zero failures/errors (1,106 outcomes; receipt test-results\audit-phase1-regression.xml). Source edits occurred during the full run, so it is not source-bound. User selected focused-check publication; full source-bound validation is BLOCKED because concurrent source edits make stable-source verification unavailable. Workflow YAML structure was checked but no remote CI run was observed. These reported checks do not yet establish the complete test requirement.
mvpRequirements.recommendedChange: After the parent completes wrapper restoration, run the required suite groups from a clean checkout and retain machine-readable reports with commit, environment, and command provenance.

mvpRequirements.title: End-to-end demo
mvpRequirements.criterion: A documented clean-reset demo runs ingestion→graph→query→UI→VS Code→GraphRAG→MCP→backup/restore from persisted data.
mvpRequirements.limitation: No clean-reset demonstration, cross-surface run, or restored-state demonstration was performed.
mvpRequirements.recommendedChange: Run the canonical clean-reset demo in sequence, preserve outputs for each surface, and finish by restoring a backup and repeating the golden trace/impact checks.

coreCatalogs.reason: Requirements were extracted from the normative catalogs, but current implementation and full acceptance evidence were not reviewed.

legacyGapAndG2Catalogs.reason: These documents were identifier-scanned but not read in full; do not interpret their contents as current findings or requirements without reconciliation.

knownAcceptanceGates.scope: Jira/Git/GitLab fixtures are required for MVP; live on-prem adapters and other source integrations need separate evidence.
GraphRAG model-on inference and model-down structured fallback require separate proof; local/model capability is not established by configuration alone.
MVP stores temporal/version fields and current-state queries; point-in-time reconstruction, snapshots, and diffs are Phase 5, not present-tense truth.
MVP backup/restore acceptance is distinct from enterprise disaster-recovery targets, HA, and measured RPO/RTO; roadmap hardening is later-phase.
Required in P1 and must be verified in an extension host with exact symbol range/context.
Offline/restricted operation and SBOM/dependency/license outputs are explicit acceptance concerns; staging images/models is not proof of a clean offline run.
The stated dataset/hardware and latency/readiness thresholds are targets, not measured claims; no benchmark was run.

ambiguitiesAndResolutions.resolution: No MVP role matrix does not imply unauthenticated deployment. Preserve single-user/local authentication, network isolation, and the explicit rule that URL namespaces are not authorization boundaries.

User/agent/MCP graph operations remain read-only. Administrative ingestion, validation, backup, restore, and schema functions are explicit application operations; this does not authorize arbitrary Gremlin or agent writes.
MVP temporal/version fields and current-state views are not a claim of live or point-in-time truth. Graph snapshots/diffs and temporal intelligence are Phase 5.

ambiguitiesAndResolutions.topic: Synthetic tenant examples versus product authorization
ambiguitiesAndResolutions.resolution: Do not infer tenant isolation or RBAC from synthetic multi-tenant/demo data; authentication and isolation requirements stand independently.
Use the user-resolved casing: Demo\demodata\manual, Demo\demodata\pipelines, Demo\script\script.md, presentation.pptx, and Demo\autodemo.
Record thresholds as acceptance targets only. They become claims only after measured results include dataset, hardware, version, and percentile.
No supplied real Jira schema is claimed as analyzed; fixtures remain synthetic until a real source schema is provided and mapped.
Identifier scan is not authority reconciliation. Preserve existing IDs, read each catalog fully, resolve duplicates/superseded proposals, and map scope/phase before treating a legacy gap as active.

recommendedPhases.focus: Source-bind the restored validation/evidence harness with a stable rerun, freeze authoritative contract choices, inventory the complete current requirements, and establish attributable baseline evidence.
Prove all 28 integrated vertical-slice acceptance rows from persisted HugeGraph data, including no-egress, safe read surfaces, extension, local GraphRAG, MCP, backup/restore, and documented demo.
Confluence/ServiceNow connectors and explicit RDF/OWL/JSON-LD interoperability adapter.
Evaluate optional local embeddings/vector retrieval and advanced RAG strategies against a reproducible baseline.
Add multi-agent workflows only where justified, bounded by P1 tool/runtime controls.
Add snapshots/diffs and historical/point-in-time graph intelligence without presenting snapshots as live truth.
Introduce explicit human approval and governed write automation, retaining separate read/write tool registries.
Evaluate enterprise RBAC/SSO, HA, quotas, tenancy/isolation and operational DR/SLO requirements.
Controlled self-modifying proposals only with governance, sandboxing, evaluation, approval, and rollback.
